title: Facilities Imunologie
html:
IL has outstanding research equipment for studying cellular and molecular processes involved in immunological mechanisms:

Cell culture facilities: sterile cell cultures facilities

Complete unit cell culture facilities BSLII and storage facilities in -1960C liquid nitrogen, deep freezers -800C, Nikon 200 microscopes, automatic cell counter Countess (Promega)

Proteomics: VarioSkan Microplate Multimode Detector; Protein microarray and cell array system (Innoscan 1100), NGS chromatographic system (BioRad), standard complete ELISA lines

Cellular physiology xCELLigence, flow citometry BD FACSCanto™ II, BD FACSDiva™6

Genomic analysis: ArrayIT Microarray Scanner

Molecular genetics facility: RT-PCR (Corbett), NanoDrop

Animal models equipments: CatWalk™XT System
